example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব ছালপাতলা, একটু সমালোচনা করলেই আহত বোধ করে।
ছালপাতলা মানুষের সঙ্গে কথা বলতে সতর্ক থাকতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is very thin-skinned and feels hurt at the slightest criticism.
You have to be careful when talking to thin-skinned people.
note: This idiom draws from the physical metaphor of thin skin to describe emotional vulnerability, common in everyday Bengali speech.
